# Fate UI v0.9.4-beta1

A prerelease that makes every provider one click away.

## Added

- **Add any provider from models.dev.** /login and Settings now open one unified provider window: sign-in providers from the embedded Pi runtime and the live models.dev catalog of about 190 providers in a single searchable list. Pick one, paste its API key if you have one, and its full model list lands in Fate UI provider storage with pricing, reasoning effort maps, and tool and structured-output flags. The key goes to the local credential store only; models.json keeps an environment-variable reference.
- **SuperGrok sign-in.** SuperGrok (xAI subscription OAuth) is built in: sign in through /login with your SuperGrok account, then use models such as `supergrok/grok-4.3`. The list starts from a bundled seed and merges the live xAI catalog once signed in.
- **Provider logos everywhere.** Provider rows now carry their models.dev logo, tinted to your theme. Logos load live, are never cached, and stay hidden when offline.

## Changed

- One provider window instead of three: the old sign-in dialog and the separate add-provider dialog are merged into the same window used by /login, first-run Connect your AI, and Settings.
- The provider window waits out a short logo prefetch before it appears, so it opens fully formed instead of visibly downloading icons.
- Managed model lists refresh from models.dev once per app start; offline starts keep the last cached list. The bundled CrofAI provider is gone — add crof.ai from the catalog instead, with the same sign-in flow.

## Verification

- Local validation: TypeScript typecheck, the full unit suite (151 files, 1439 tests), and a production build.
- GitHub Actions runs the standard four-platform pipeline: build, install, and smoke test on Windows x64, macOS Apple Silicon, macOS Intel, and Linux x64.

## Notes

- Public beta installers are unsigned. Verify each download against the `SHA256SUMS` file shipped with the release.
